description: Defines the AccountTreeGrid class extending frappe.views.TreeGridReport for rendering and managing an account tree grid with filters, columns, and balance calculations in a financial application.

classes.name: AccountTreeGrid
classes.description: A class for rendering an account tree grid report with filters, columns, and balance calculations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the AccountTreeGrid with filters, columns, and setup.

methods.name: setup_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the account tree grid.

methods.name: setup_filters
methods.description: Sets up filters for the report, including default behaviors.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares account data and balances for display.

methods.name: prepare_balances
methods.description: Calculates opening, closing, debit, and credit balances.

methods.name: update_balances
methods.description: Updates account balances based on posting date and entries.

methods.name: set_debit_or_credit
methods.description: Sets debit or credit balance for an account.

methods.name: update_groups
methods.description: Updates parent group balances based on child accounts.

methods.name: set_fiscal_year
methods.description: Determines the fiscal year based on date filters.

methods.name: show_general_ledger
methods.description: Navigates to the General Ledger report for a specific account.
